# Diana Pinzon — Marketing Automation Specialist & Co-founder of Vulcano

> Marketing automation specialist based in Tunja, Boyacá, Colombia (EST/COT), and
> co-founder of Vulcano, a software, data and process-automation engineering studio.
> Builds marketing and sales automations with n8n, Zapier, GoHighLevel and HubSpot that
> connect CRM, prospecting and email, plus web development (React, Astro, Vite, Webflow),
> automated campaigns and conversion-focused copywriting. Background in psychology and
> quantitative data analysis. Works in Spanish and English, remote worldwide.

## Services

- Marketing and sales automation: end-to-end workflows with n8n, Zapier, GoHighLevel and
  HubSpot — CRM pipelines, follow-ups, WhatsApp conversation flows, behavior-based nurturing
- Lead generation and cold outreach: prospecting with Apollo and LinkedIn Sales Navigator,
  cold email with SalesHandy and Instantly, smart segmentation, personalized sequences
- Web development and landing pages: React, Astro, Vite and Webflow — marketing funnels,
  internal apps and dashboards, forms, lead capture and event tracking
- Content, copywriting and personal branding: thought-leadership positioning, automated
  newsletters, consumer-psychology-driven messaging

## Selected projects

- OMW Operations Dashboard — cost, client, appointment and pipeline visibility for On My Way,
  with n8n consolidating GoHighLevel CRM data. Stack: n8n, GoHighLevel, React, REST API.
- WhatsApp Customer Service Bot — 24/7 automated support with EvolutionAPI, self-hosted n8n,
  Redis and OpenAI, including voice-note transcription and human handoff.
- LinkedIn Content Creation System — AI-assisted post, carousel and calendar automation;
  reported a 300% increase in engagement and 15+ hours saved per week.
- AI-Powered CV Builder — ATS-compatible résumé generator with AI copy optimization:
  https://github.com/Diana020828/word-craft-pro
- Modern Portfolio Website — responsive React + TypeScript + Tailwind site with automated CI/CD.
